[h2][b]EARLY ACCESS IS OVER![/b][/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that the game has finally left the Early Access development phase. A big "Thank you" to each and every broadcaster who supported us during this incredibly fascinating period. Your support means the world to us and memes that you share on our [url=https://discord.gg/vVtShDUsCv]Discord[/url] have become an essential part of our lives.

If you own the Early Access version, you don't need to purchase [i][b]Not For Broadcast[/b][/i] again or pay extra money. Please, update the game via your Steam client.

[h2][b]THE FINAL VERSION OF THE GAME IS HERE![/b][/h2]

The 1.0 version is live! Witness the climax of the dystopian tale of power, resistance, and the decline of humankind.

[h3][b]FEATURES[/b][/h3]
You decide what makes the news ː80sTVː. Bleep swears, run ads, switch between cameras and...change the world, mate.
[list]
[*] ːvhsvideoː Three huge episodes, including the newly released [b]Episode 3[/b]
[*] ːdisruptː [b]Several endings[/b] that depend on choices you make throughout the game
[*] 🏆 [b]New achievements[/b], [b]challenges[/b], and [b]rewards[/b]
[*]🌐 [b][url=https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/88911-most-full-motion-video-footage-in-a-videogame]Guinness World Record[/url][/b] for the most full-motion video in a game: [b]43 bloody hours[/b]!
[/list]
